environment.description: Go 1.21 microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in a private VPC subnet. The service uses AWS KMS for signing operations (key alias: alias/signing-prod). The container runs as non-root (uid 1000). Environment variables KMS_ENDPOINT and SIGNING_KEY_ID are injected via Secrets Manager. No WAF or API gateway in front of the ALB. The ALB forwards all POST requests directly to the container on port 8080. The container's IAM task role has kms:Sign permission but not kms:GetKeyPolicy or kms:DescribeKey beyond what's needed for signing.

config.network: Private subnet, ALB public-facing, no WAF
config.secrets: AWS Secrets Manager for env vars
